title: Leti language
description: Austronesian language spoken in Maluku, Indonesia
extract: Leti is an Austronesian language spoken on the island of Leti in Maluku, Indonesia. Although it shares much vocabulary with the neighboring Luang language, it is marginally mutually intelligible.
